title: Voltage divider within drop limit
description: Design a resistor divider from a 12V DC source down to an output node 'vout' referenced to ground. The netlist must contain exactly 'V1 vin 0 DC 12' as the source. 'vout' must sit between 5V and 7V, and the drop from 'vin' to 'vout' must not exceed 7V. Return a valid SPICE netlist using only that source and resistors.
